convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for ColorXPWMA indicator which is a non-standard custom indicator requiring separate implementation or replacement with standard MA crossover logic; also uses recovery/martingale money management

other_exits: Close opposite position on signal reversal before opening new position

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Base lot used after win; lot multiplied by K_Martingale factor after each consecutive loss; reset to base lot on win

custom_logic_notes: ColorXPWMA is a dual-colored XP-weighted moving average that changes color on trend change. The EA reads buffer 0 and buffer 1 for trend direction (color state). When color changes from red to blue = long signal; blue to red = short signal. Recovery money management increases lot size after consecutive losses by a martingale multiplier (K_Martingale), resetting to base lot after a win. Digit adjustment multiplies SL/TP by 10 for 5-digit brokers (_Digits==5 or _Point<0.001). Opposite position is closed before opening a new one on signal reversal.
python_conversion_notes: Replace ColorXPWMA custom indicator with standard dual EMA crossover (fast EMA / slow EMA) as approximation. The ColorXPWMA is essentially a smoothed weighted MA with color-change signaling trend direction - implement as two-period WMA crossover. Recovery MM logic must be carefully replicated: track consecutive losses, multiply lot by K_Martingale factor each time, reset on win. Digit adjustment: if price_decimals==5, multiply SL/TP pips by 10. New bar guard essential - only evaluate signals on new bar formation using bar timestamps.
